newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firmer, interbank rate jumps late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firmer, interbank rate jumps late.

text.p: The Thai baht was stronger against the dollar near the close on Tuesday on talk of possible intervention in offshore markets to defend the currency, dealers said.
Bank of Thailand official were not available for comment on the intervention talk.
The baht rose to 25.900/25.910 in late trade from 25.935/25.945 in early morning, dealers said.
"There was very heavy selling of the dollar in the afternoon. There was talk of central bank intervention, but I can not confirm it," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Some players were also seen arbitraging by buying dollars from the central bank at a lower level than the interbank spot rate and then selling it to the market, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.88 per dollar against 25.85 on Monday.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 11.00-12.00 percent late from 9.50-10.00 percent early as banks borrowed funds to speculate on the dollar, dealers said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 6.25/7.25 satangs per dollar against 6.00/7.00 earlier.
